answer: According to the Upanishads, Atman is identical with Brahman, the ultimate reality. The Taittiriya Upanishad teaches that Atman is the Supreme Self, the source of all existence, described as pure consciousness and bliss beyond the scope of speech and thought. The Taittiriya Upanishad explains Brahman as the Supreme Self, entirely distinct from the world, and as the source of everything. It describes Brahman as the unconditioned, non-dual bliss, beyond the scope of speech and thought, and as indescribable and incomprehensible.
